top_signals.title: U.S. moves to curb China’s remote access to Nvidia’s AI chips
top_signals.summary: The measure seeks to restrict China and other U.S. adversaries from accessing offshore computing power that uses American-designed processors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Colombia’s De La Espriella Vows Spending Cuts in Investor Pitch
top_signals.summary: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella pledged spending cuts and fiscal discipline as he sought to reassure investors amid one of the country’s most severe fiscal crises in decades.
